blinding_guess.why: The nodelet advertises geometry_msgs/Twist on private 'velocity', which every launch file that runs it against the base remaps to mobile_base/commands/velocity, and it fills only linear.x (m/s) and angular.z (rad/s) as Twist defines them; the interactive script publishes the same type on the same topic. Nothing in the listed elements looks inconsistent at this revision.

notes: ROS 1 (hydro): all QoS fields are null. Two publishers in this package provide topic mobile_base/commands/velocity: (1) the AutoDockingNodelet (library kobuki_auto_docking_ros) advertises relative name "velocity" on the nodelet private NodeHandle (src/nodelet.cpp:64 passes getPrivateNodeHandle(); nodelet name dock_drive), queue 10, published once per synchronized odom/core/dock_ir callback only when dock_.canRun() (src/auto_docking_ros.cpp:132-137); no rate is fixed in code. launch/minimal.launch, compact.launch and standalone.launch remap dock_drive/velocity to mobile_base/commands/velocity; launch/auto_dock_with_safe_keyop.launch instead remaps it to cmd_vel_mux/auto_docking and remaps cmd_vel_mux/output (another package's nodelet) to mobile_base/commands/velocity. (2) scripts/DockDriveControl.py (installed program) publishes '/mobile_base/commands/velocity' (absolute, leading slash as written) with geometry_msgs/Twist from a rospy.Timer of 0.1 s (line 129, 10 Hz) while motors are toggled on; rate_hz left null because the nodelet publisher, the package's primary provider, sets no rate. frame is null for all ports: Twist has no header and the code names no frame. Published values pass through DockDrive::setVel, which enforces minimum magnitudes min_abs_v=0.01 and min_abs_w=0.1 (src/dock_drive.cpp:66-67, 74-78; overridable by params min_abs_v/min_abs_w read at src/auto_docking_ros.cpp:47-51). The msg element geometry_msgs/Twist is not defined in the snapshot; its definition was fetched from ros/common_msgs tag 1.10.6 (last 1.10.x tag, the hydro series; 1.10.2 and 1.10.6 Twist/Vector3 are byte-identical; 1.10.7-1.10.10 do not exist) and hashed with definition_hash.py; a one-line stub package.xml naming geometry_msgs was placed beside the fetched files in a scratch directory so the tool could resolve the package name. The md5 9f195f881246fdfa2798d1d3eebca84a is Twist's. Not packet elements but present: action server name_+"_action" (dock_drive_action) of kobuki_msgs/AutoDockingAction, publisher debug/feedback (std_msgs/String), subscriber debug/mode_shift (std_msgs/String), params min_abs_v/min_abs_w; publisher member motor_power_enabler_ is declared but never advertised although launch files remap dock_drive/motor_power. auto_docking_ros.hpp does not include geometry_msgs/Twist.h directly (reached transitively via nav_msgs/Odometry.h). Consumed topic names are given as the launch-file remap targets; in code they are private relative names odom/core/dock_ir.
